title: Concerted effort among regions needed to address AI as ‘concern for everybody’: lawmaker
summary: A “concerted effort” among regions is needed to address artificial intelligence (AI), as it is a “concern for everybody,” House Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand Hernandez said on Wednesday.
